column1: # the #IQ{...}# island's syntax-case ratchet (IqSyntaxCasesTest): per policy and verdict, how many of iq-parity/syntax-cases.jsonl the
# reader gives that verdict; then each reject case it parses and each accepting case it rejects (lists that only shrink).
# Rewrite with -Diq.syntax.update=<this file's path in the workspace>; a regression is refused.
# IQ island, 2026-10-14 (the second review's B3): syntax-cases.jsonl re-derived with stricter filters, so the pins are
# re-seeded from it: 1,601 of the 8,770 cases dropped (637 whose research note or rule marks a documentation example,
# 752 sharing a run of six words with the manuals' text, 12 holding a two-word name the manuals print, 11 a demo
# database name, 189 a 12-character string the manuals print). Shrinkage only: every kept case is unchanged and keeps
# its verdict; the reject-parsed and accept-rejected lists lose 5 and 2 ids and gain none.
# IQ island, 2026-10-14 (M1a): the reader now reads BETWEEN, IN lists, LIKE, IS [NOT] DISTINCT FROM and the truth tests
# (IS [NOT] TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN), and sa_rowgenerator in FROM: accept PARSED 659 -> 765 (REFUSED 4,465 -> 4,359); reject
# REJECTED 587 -> 592 (BETWEEN without AND, an empty IN list, IN without a list, a truth test in the select list, IN in a
# call: IQ's syntax errors), REFUSED 1,197 -> 1,192; reject PARSED stays 31, its list unchanged (a constant LIKE escape or
# pattern IQ raises an error for is refused before translation). Every parsed case was snapped on SQL Anywhere 17 and run
# on the DuckDB lane: none answers otherwise.
# IQ island, 2026-10-14 (M1b): the reader now reads joins (comma, [INNER], LEFT, RIGHT, FULL, CROSS, NATURAL),
# derived tables, parenthesized joins and queries, subqueries (scalar, EXISTS, IN, ANY/SOME/ALL) and UNION, EXCEPT and
# INTERSECT, with the errors IQ raises before running that the cases agree on (-131 USING, a second ON, CROSS JOIN ON, a
# derived table without a name; -139, -151, -152, -163 for an unnamed expression, -812, -824): accept PARSED 765 -> 1,490
# (REFUSED 4,359 -> 3,634), flag PARSED 8 -> 28, reject REJECTED 592 -> 642 (REFUSED 1,192 -> 1,147). Reject PARSED
# 31 -> 26: five names no FROM item has (a1_sa_lang-850 and -1745, a6_sa_query-198 and -199, s1_lexical-578) are refused
# before translation now. Where the cases call one form accept in one case and reject in another, each measured as an
# error on SQL Anywhere 17 (a set operation's branches of different widths, -153; a name in a set operation's ORDER BY
# its first branch does not show, -854; a derived table's short column list, -163; a name no derived table has, -142,
# -143, -144; a correlation name over 128 bytes, -250), the reader refuses by name, naming IQ's error, rather than give
# either verdict: no accept case is rejected and no reject case parses that did not before. Every parsed case (1,537
# snapped on SQL Anywhere 17; 7 holding control characters or a statement separator, 1 outside Latin-1, left out) was run
# on the DuckDB lane: PASS 1,279, BOTH_ERROR 49, REFUSED 209, none otherwise.
# IQ island, 2026-10-14 (M1c): the reader now reads GROUP BY, HAVING and the aggregates COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX,
# MEDIAN and LIST: accept PARSED 1,490 -> 1,901 (REFUSED 3,634 -> 3,223), flag PARSED 28 -> 48, reject REJECTED 642 -> 723
# (-150 an aggregate in WHERE, ON or GROUP BY; -149 and -854 a column no GROUP BY item reads, where the FROM items'
# columns are known; -861 an aggregate over an enclosing query's column and its own; -154, -949, -152, -904; GROUP BY
# ALL), REFUSED 1,147 -> 1,068. Reject PARSED 26 -> 24: s1_lexical-1622 (an owner-qualified table, now refused by name as
# the study's open O2 says) and s2_query-74 (sa_rowgenerator without its parentheses, refused by name) leave the list.
# The owner-qualified refusal moves 11 accept cases from PARSED to REFUSED (dba.t, mydb.SYS.DUMMY, ...: the island refused
# each when translating already). Where the cases call a form accept in one case and reject in another, each measured as
# an error on SQL Anywhere 17, the reader refuses by name with IQ's code rather than give either verdict, as M1b did:
# NOT NOT (-131: s1_lexical-1015 accept, a1_sa_lang-690 reject), an ON naming an item before the comma (-824:
# z2_redteam-836 accept, a6_sa_query-431 and s2_query-147 reject), two correlation names alike but for case (-139:
# z2_redteam-866, -867 accept). No accept case is rejected and no reject case parses that did not before. Every parsed
# case (1,964 snapped on SQL Anywhere 17; 9 holding control characters, a statement separator or a character outside
# Latin-1 left out) was run on the DuckDB lane: PASS 1,552, BOTH_ERROR 46, REFUSED 366, none otherwise.
# IQ island, 2026-10-14 (M1d): the reader now reads CAST and a CONVERT without a style (a style, a type of which the
# island reads no value, and a constant IQ cannot convert are refused by name), CURRENT DATE, CURRENT TIMESTAMP, f(*),
# the date-part keyword of DATEPART, DATENAME, DATEADD and DATEDIFF (a string or an unknown part is IQ's -131), and the
# function catalog's argument counts (IQ's -154): accept PARSED 765 -> 1,315 (REFUSED 4,359 -> 3,809); flag PARSED 8 ->
# 10 (DATEADD of a weekday and of a calendar week), REFUSED 128 -> 126; reject REJECTED 592 -> 697 (counts, date parts,
# type sizes), REFUSED 1,192 -> 1,087; reject PARSED stays 31 and accept-rejected 2, both lists unchanged (other
# dialects' CHARINDEX, ROUND and LOG forms and a constant negative SUBSTRING length are refused before translation). The
# 535 newly parsed cases without options, each select item aliased, were snapped on SQL Anywhere 17 and run on both
# lanes: none answers otherwise but the seven that show the clock itself (CURRENT TIMESTAMP, NOW(), GETDATE(*)).
# IQ island, 2026-10-14 (the merge of M1b/M1c with M1d and the natives slice): the pins re-written from the merged
# reader, and only improved on both parents' (M1c's above, and M1d's: accept PARSED 1,315, flag PARSED 10, reject
# REJECTED 697, reject PARSED 31): accept PARSED 2,689 (REFUSED 2,435, REJECTED 1), flag PARSED 50 (REFUSED 86), reject
# REJECTED 838 (REFUSED 953, PARSED 24); reject-parsed 24 and accept-rejected 2, each a subset of both parents' lists.
# Per case, against M1c: 788 accept, 2 flag REFUSED -> PARSED and 114 reject REFUSED -> REJECTED, none worse; against
# M1d: 1,385 accept and 40 flag REFUSED -> PARSED, 140 reject REFUSED -> REJECTED, 7 reject PARSED -> REFUSED, and the
# 11 owner-qualified accept cases M1c's note above moves to REFUSED. Two forms CAST newly lets the reader see through
# were closed in the code, not here: MEDIAN of a CAST to BIT or a date is IQ's -156 before translating (a4_sa_fn2-569),
# and GROUP BY of an integer constant beside a column it does not group is refused naming IQ's -149 where the cases
# call it accepted (z2_redteam-333, -334; IQ groups by the constant, other dialects by the position). Every parsed case
# (2,718 snapped on SQL Anywhere 17; 45 holding control characters, a statement separator or a character outside
# Latin-1 left out) was run on the DuckDB lane: PASS 1,926, BOTH_ERROR 50, REFUSED 733, and nine that show the clock
# itself (CURRENT TIMESTAMP, NOW(), GETDATE(): SQL Anywhere's local time against lite's UTC), none otherwise.
# IQ island, 2026-10-14 (review 4's m3): syntax-cases.jsonl re-checked with the literal filter run over every iq-parity
# file (a string the manuals print quoted anywhere -- four or more characters, three letters among them, or eight or
# more -- unless it is one English word, a date or a number; or one printed quoted on a manual line that calls the
# probe's function, a word too; or a run of six words of the manuals' text other than SQL's own words): 186 of the
# 7,169 cases dropped (176 accept, 2 accept-with-option, 2 flag, 6 reject). Shrinkage only: every kept case is unchanged
# and keeps its verdict; accept PARSED 2,689 -> 2,658 and REFUSED 2,435 -> 2,290, accept-with-option REFUSED 92 -> 90,
# flag REFUSED 86 -> 84, reject REFUSED 953 -> 947; the reject-parsed and accept-rejected lists are unchanged.
# IQ island, 2026-10-14 (M1e): an owner-qualified table name parses now and is bound to the model's tables when
# translated (the study's O2: an owner is a schema; IQ's own users' tables, its catalog, stay refused by name), and so
# do T-SQL's db..t and SQL Anywhere's DUMMY through its database and server qualifiers; a constant date string is read
# by the profile's DATE_ORDER (IqDateTime): accept PARSED 2,689 -> 2,705 (REFUSED 2,435 -> 2,419): thirteen names
# (s1_lexical-1579, -1580, -1581; z2_redteam-96, -98 .. -103, -890, -892, -893) and three date constants
# (z2_redteam-38, -911, -913). Flag, reject and the two lists unchanged (reject PARSED stays 24: the catalog's
# dbo.sys... names stay refused). The sixteen were snapped on SQL Anywhere 17 and run on both lanes: PASS 8,
# BOTH_ERROR 2, REFUSED 6 (three owner-qualified column references, three unaliased CASTs), none otherwise.
# IQ island, 2026-10-14 (the merge of M1e with review 4's fixes): the pins re-written from the merged reader over
# review 4's case file (its 186 dropped cases stay dropped; none of M1e's sixteen is among them): accept PARSED
# 2,658 -> 2,674 (REFUSED 2,290 -> 2,274), every other count and both lists unchanged. Per case over this file, against
# review 4's reader only M1e's sixteen move (REFUSED -> PARSED), and against M1e's reader none moves.
# IQ island, 2026-10-14 (the third landing, the M1 gaps): a select-list alias is read where IQ reads it (WHERE, ON,
# the select list, GROUP BY, HAVING), a FROM-less subquery is read, TOP in a subquery with ORDER BY under SQL Anywhere's
# engine, and a non-catalog name an owner of IQ's own qualifies parses (bound when translated to the model's schema of
# that name, else refused by name): accept PARSED 2,674 -> 2,687 (REFUSED 2,274 -> 2,261), thirteen cases
# -825). Flag, reject and both lists unchanged. The thirteen were snapped on SQL Anywhere 17 and run on both lanes:
# PASS 9, REFUSED 3 (a duplicate output name; two FROM-less union branches inside a subquery), BOTH_ERROR 1 (a
# temporary table dbo qualifies, refused by name), none otherwise.
# IQ island, 2026-10-14 (review 7's m5, the note above only; no count moves): that BOTH_ERROR is a refusal by name
# where SQL Anywhere raises its own error (-141, the temporary table not found), which the harness judges a
# BOTH_ERROR, not a REFUSED. Review 7's fixes move no syntax case's verdict (every one of the 6,983 identical).
# IQ island, 2026-10-15 (landing 4, common table expressions; IQ 17.1's rules measured on the live server): the reader
# now reads WITH at the head of the statement and of a derived table, each CTE read as the derived table it names:
# accept PARSED 2,687 -> 2,717 (REFUSED 2,261 -> 2,231); reject REJECTED 838 -> 839 (REFUSED 947 -> 946: a WITH at the
# head of a CTE's query, IQ's -131). A CTE named inside its own reading (IQ's -938, a cycle -914) is refused by name with
# IQ's code, as M1b's note does where the cases disagree: z2_redteam-763 calls it accept, a6_sa_query-92,
# c09_statements-70 and s2_query-346 reject. Reject-parsed and accept-rejected unchanged.
# IQ island, 2026-10-15 (landing 4, window functions; IQ 17.1's rules measured on the live server, IqWindows): the reader
# now reads OVER (...), OVER name and WINDOW, the ranking functions, LAG, LEAD, FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE and the
# aggregates over a window, with the errors IQ raises before running (-131, -154, -947 to -950, -964, -1331, -134):
# accept PARSED 2,717 -> 2,907 (REFUSED 2,231 -> 2,041), flag PARSED 50 -> 65 (REFUSED 84 -> 69), reject REJECTED
# 839 -> 956 (REFUSED 946 -> 829). Reject-parsed and accept-rejected unchanged.
# IQ island, 2026-10-15 (landing 4, the IQ engine's rules measured on the live IQ 17.1: subquery positions, TOP and LIST
# without ORDER BY, MIN/MAX/UNION/DISTINCT/GROUP BY over strings, NUMERIC arithmetic, DATEADD/DATEDIFF, ROUND, CEILING,
# FLOOR, CONVERT of dates, LIKE over CHAR(n) and computed patterns with ESCAPE, ISNUMERIC and YEARS/MONTHS/WEEKS/DAYS/HOURS/
# MINUTES/SECONDS): accept PARSED 2,907 -> 2,934 (REFUSED 2,041 -> 2,014); reject REJECTED 956 -> 962 (REFUSED 829 ->
# 823: those functions' argument counts, IQ's -154). Reject-parsed and accept-rejected unchanged.
# IQ island, 2026-10-15 (landing 4, CONVERT with a style under IQ's engine, measured on the live IQ 17.1: a date's or a
# timestamp's text by styles 0-5, 10-12, 20, 21, 100-108, 110-112, 120 and 121; another style refused by name): accept
# PARSED 2,934 -> 2,974 (REFUSED 2,014 -> 1,974). Reject-parsed and accept-rejected unchanged.
# IQ island, 2026-10-15 (landing 4, STR under IQ's engine, measured on the live IQ 17.1): accept PARSED 2,974 -> 2,986
# (REFUSED 1,974 -> 1,962); reject REJECTED 962 -> 963 (REFUSED 823 -> 822: STR's argument count, IQ's -154).
# Reject-parsed and accept-rejected unchanged.
# IQ island, 2026-10-15 (landing 4, EXTRACT, measured on the live IQ 17.1): accept PARSED 2,986 -> 2,989 (REFUSED
# 1,962 -> 1,959). Reject-parsed and accept-rejected unchanged.
# IQ island, 2026-10-15 (landing 4, checklist 0.7 and the IQ engine's refusals, measured on the live IQ 17.1: DATEFORMAT,
# DAYNAME, MONTHNAME, DATETIME, YMD, the calendar parts; DATETIME of a number and YMD past the years 1 to 9999 refused
# by name): accept PARSED 2,989 -> 3,016 (REFUSED 1,959 -> 1,932); reject REJECTED 963 -> 966 (REFUSED 822 -> 819).
# Reject-parsed and accept-rejected unchanged.
# IQ island, 2026-10-15 (checklist 1.10, measured on the live IQ 17.1: GREATER, LESSER, ARGN, REVERSE, INSERTSTR,
